intro.label: Engagements
intro.title: Ways we can work together.
intro.lead: Our engagements are structured models, not fixed-price packages. Each one is shaped around the business concept, target market, investment size, industry, complexity, technology needs, partnership structure and geographic scope.

philosophy.label: Levels of engagement
philosophy.title:
We don’t sell isolated services.
We take an opportunity as far as it needs to go.

levels.name: Advise
levels.quote: We help you understand what to do.

levels.name: Build
levels.quote: We build the solution with you.

levels.name: Launch
levels.quote: We help you bring it to market.

levels.name: Partner
levels.quote: We build and operate opportunities together.

packages.name: Investment Advisory
packages.headline:
Find the opportunity.
Test it properly.
packages.lead: For investors who want access to opportunities across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and Central Asia — and an independent, investor-grade view before committing capital.
packages.idealClient: Family offices, private investors and investment companies.

groups.title: Sourcing
items: Access through founders, operators and local partners

groups.title: Structuring
items: Legal and tax coordination with qualified counsel

packages.name: Market Entry
packages.short: Enter Saudi Arabia, the GCC or Central Asia with the right strategy and partners.
packages.headline:
Enter a new market
with the right structure.
packages.lead: For companies and investors entering Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Uzbekistan, Central Asia or Europe — from market intelligence to the first customers.
packages.idealClient: International companies, investors and regional groups expanding across borders.

packages.name: Business Build
packages.short: Turn a concept into a commercially viable business.
packages.headline:
From business concept
to market.
packages.lead: We help turn an idea into a commercially viable business — from market validation and business model design to product development, market entry, monetisation and launch.
packages.idealClient: Entrepreneurs, family offices and corporates launching a new business.

steps.name: Market
steps.text: Identify and validate the target market.

steps.name: Business model
steps.text: Define how the business creates and captures value.

steps.name: Product
steps.text: Design and build the required product or platform.

steps.name: Monetisation
steps.text: Develop revenue streams and pricing logic.

steps.name: Go-to-market
steps.text: Build the marketing and sales strategy.

steps.name: Structure
steps.text: Establish the financial and legal framework.

steps.name: Launch
steps.text: Support the launch and initial operations.

packages.name: Joint Venture
packages.short: Create a new business with a strategic partner.
packages.headline:
Build the right venture
with the right partner.
packages.lead: We help investors, companies and strategic partners transform complementary capabilities into new businesses.
packages.idealClient: Investors, international companies and local groups with complementary strengths.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: Create the business model and operating model.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Develop the required product and technology.

packages.name: Digital Product
packages.short: Design and build the technology required to execute the business model.
packages.headline:
Have the business idea.
We build the product.
packages.lead: For clients with a business concept who need the technology to run it — designed around the business model, not the other way round.
packages.idealClient: Founders, corporates and ventures that need a platform built.

packages.name: AI Transformation
packages.short: Identify, implement and scale AI opportunities.
packages.headline:
Put AI where it
actually matters.
packages.lead: AI as a mechanism for lower operating costs, higher productivity, faster decisions and better service — not as a standalone technology project.
packages.idealClient: Operating companies, corporate groups and institutions.

groups.title: AI pilots
items: Rapid tests of high-value use cases

groups.title: AI implementation
items: Integration into existing systems and workflows

groups.title: AI intelligence
items: Turn business data into actionable information

groups.title: AI governance
items: Security, access, data and responsible-use principles

packages.name: Growth Engine
packages.short: Build marketing, sales, CRM and commercial infrastructure.
packages.headline:
Build demand.
Build sales.
Build distribution.
packages.lead: A complete commercialisation engagement combining strategy, technology and execution — so growth does not depend on a few individuals.
packages.idealClient: Companies launching, entering a market or scaling revenue.

packages.name: Business Structure
packages.short: Build the financial, corporate and legal architecture with qualified partners.
packages.headline:
Build the structure
behind the opportunity.
packages.lead: Strategic financial structuring and corporate architecture — designed for how the business needs to operate, and delivered together with qualified legal, tax and financial partners.
packages.idealClient: Ventures, JVs, investors and companies entering new markets.
packages.note: This is strategic structuring, not regulated legal, tax or accounting advice. We coordinate the required legal and corporate work with qualified local and international counsel, and financial and tax matters with qualified advisers.

packages.name: Full Business Launch
packages.short: Our most comprehensive engagement — from strategy to scale, coordinated by one partner.
packages.headline:
Build the business.
Enter the market.
Make it work.
packages.lead: Our most comprehensive engagement model. One strategic partner coordinates the full chain — strategy, structure, product, go-to-market, operations and scale — instead of a client managing a dozen disconnected advisers.
packages.idealClient: Investors, family offices and companies building a significant new business or market presence.
deliverables: Corporate, legal and financial structure (with counsel)
